facts.title: Simple Blueberry Cake
ingredients: 1 ¾ cups plus 1 teaspoon white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour
½ cup maple syrup or honey
3 cups blueberries, fresh (1 ½ pints) or frozen, divided
1 tablespoon turbinado sugar (also called raw sugar), for sprinkling on top
Optional serving suggestions: Vanilla ice cream, Greek yogurt or whipped cream
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
